messages:
elaine (design): quick design check — in the drilldown compact list the correlation-id pill gets visually lost next to error badges. feels like users miss it when scanning. screenshot: https://redwood.design/figs/cid-compact.png

sam (product): agree. main problem is density. two ideas: persistent pill to the left of line OR keep it in overflow but show first 8 chars + copy. which is higher priority?

mike (eng-runtime): persistent pill is doable but we should avoid adding a heavy DOM node per row (we render thousands). copy button per-row impacts perf. lazy render the button on hover/focus is fine.

jordan (eng-platform): also watch out for color collisions — our status badges use the same muted tag color; if we make pill persistent it should reuse the tag palette but pick a non-conflicting hue.

aria (a11y): accessibility notes: when ID is truncated we MUST expose full value to screen readers. button needs aria-label='Copy correlation ID' and keyboard focus must reach it before any non-essential actions. contrast: current pill text contrast is ~3:1 which fails AA for small text.

elaine (design): microcopy proposal: "Correlation ID: abc123ef..." with a small copy icon. on hover/focus show full id as tooltip + copy action. tooltip should be accessible (role='tooltip' + aria-describedby).

mike (eng-runtime): quick pseudo example for clipboard behavior:```html
<button class="copy-cid" aria-label="Copy correlation ID" data-cid="abc123ef456">📋</button>
<script>document.querySelectorAll('.copy-cid').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',e=>navigator.clipboard.writeText(e.target.dataset.cid)) )</script>
```we'll implement lazy listeners to avoid perf hit.

sam (product): also thinking about export actions — currently each request row has an inline "download stack" which clutters. proposal: move primary Export to drilldown header, keep inline action hidden under kebab for deep dives. thoughts?

elaine (design): header-level export is cleaner. keep inline download but behind overflow menu (three dots) so power users still have quick access. will update Figma: compact variant + header export.

aria (a11y): confirm contrast before final sign-off. recommend switch to darker pill text or lighter background to get >=4.5:1. also ensure tooltip appears on keyboard focus with proper aria-live region for copy confirmation.

jordan (eng-platform): operational note: header export will require RBAC gating per-tenant (some customers disable exports). we need product flag + backend toggle.

sam (product): ok add feature flag. @mike can you estimate effort?

mike (eng-runtime): rough estimate: move export to header + backend toggle ~2 dev days, copy button + lazy listeners ~1 dev day, a11y fixes + testing ~1 dev day, QA + docs ~1 day. total ~5 dev days.

elaine (design): thanks — I'll ship updated frames for compact and standard. checklist: [ ] update Figma, [ ] add aria labels & tooltip behavior, [ ] mock overflow menu with inline download hidden, [ ] QA script for keyboard/voiceover.

deploy-bot: Deployed snapshot: design/compact-drilldown/v3 -> staging.

sam (product): will review in UI sync at 3pm today. :thumbsup:

elaine (design): great — I'll drop the Figma link in #design-updates when it's ready.
